name: Mocha Libre Latte
caffeineNote: Label: 200 mg per can, printed on the front; caffeine is also added as an ingredient, on top of what the coffee carries
summary: Zero-sugar mocha cold brew on oat milk with cocoa powder, named Mocha Libre on the can (we listed it as the Mocha Latte until we had one in hand). Same build as Loco's Vanilla — 200 mg of caffeine printed on the front, 0 g of sugar, sucralose in place of it and caffeine added on top of the coffee — at 90 calories rather than 80, with 2 g of protein and 6 g of fat.
